create_t5_model: create a T5 generation model with configurable variant, input projection, and max tokens
build_t5_forward_inference: build T5 forward pass to generate text from query embeddings without labels
test_t5_training_mode: test T5 forward pass in training mode with labels to compute loss and clamp logits
review_t5_input_projection: review T5 input projection layer that maps input features to T5 hidden size with LayerNorm
summarize_t5_tokenizer_decode: summarize T5 tokenizer batch decode that strips special tokens and decoder start token from outputs
